name: adapt_required_columns_sql_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: required_columns.txt (a spec file listing columns the items table must have) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, a new column added to the requirement); the agent must add it, not leave the stale schema in place
prompts: Write schema.sql creating a table items with, at minimum, every column listed in required_columns.txt (currently: id, name) - id as an integer primary key, all other listed columns as text.
required_columns.txt has changed. Make sure the items table has EVERY column currently listed in the file.

disruptions.description: required_columns.txt rewritten to add a new required column

test_setup_files.test_schema.py:
import sqlite3

with open('required_columns.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    required = [c.strip() for c in f.read().strip().split(',') if c.strip()]
assert required, 'required_columns.txt is empty'

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
with open('schema.sql', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    conn.executescript(f.read())

cols = {row[1] for row in conn.execute('PRAGMA table_info(items)').fetchall()}
missing = [c for c in required if c not in cols]
assert not missing, f'items table is missing required column(s) {missing} (stale schema not updated), has: {cols}'
print('PASS')
